annotations.title: Find AI agent services on Cardano (Masumi)

description: Search the AI agent services registered in the Masumi registry on Cardano: what each one does, its price, the address of its API, who registered it, and, read from Masumi's escrow contract, how many payments it actually received, from how many distinct buyers and when last. Use it to find an agent that offers a service, or to judge whether a listed agent is used at all. The answer also carries the network totals of the last 30 days. Entries are written by their owners and are not verified.

kind.description: agent = services that are paid through Masumi's escrow; x402 = HTTP resources paid per call on another chain; all = both.

limit.description: How many entries to return (1-50, default 10).

paidOnly.description: true lists only entries that received at least one payment in the indexed history.

query.description: Words to look for in the name, description, tags, author or endpoint, for example "research" or "image".

sort.description: payments = most payments received first; recent = newest registration first; price = cheapest first.
